block.title: Block the apps that pull you in.
block.body: Pick the apps and sites. Untangle steps in when you've had enough.

play.title: When the urge hits, play instead.
play.body: A quick focus game takes the place of the scroll. One round, then back to your day.

grow.title: Get your focus back.
grow.body: Short daily practice for your memory, focus and attention.

age.title: How old are you?
age.body: So we can show what your habits add up to over the years.

scrollTime.title: How much do you scroll a day?

pickups.title: How often do you pick up your phone?
pickups.body: In a day. Most people guess low.

focusSigns.title: Do any of these sound like you?

options.work: Losing focus at work or study
options.reading: Reading is harder than it was

yourYear.title: That's {{days}} days of your year.
yourYear.body: Full 24-hour days of scrolling, worked out from your answers. At this pace, that's {{later}} days by the time you're {{age}}.
yourYear.bodyNotSure: If you're like most people, that's full 24-hour days of scrolling. At this pace, that's {{later}} days by the time you're {{age}}.
yourYear.gridLabel: {{days}} of the 365 days in a year, filled in red.

problemFocus.title: Your focus is shrinking.
problemFocus.body: How long people stayed on one screen before switching to something else.
problemFocus.source: Gloria Mark, UC Irvine · workplace studies, 2004 and 2016–2020
problemFocus.chartLabel: Attention on one screen fell from 2½ minutes in 2004 to 47 seconds in 2016 to 2020, 69% less.

problemDistracted.title: You get distracted easily.
problemDistracted.body: One notification. One quick look. One more video. Twenty minutes later, you look up.

art.line2: Revenue grew 18% on the back of
art.line3: two new partners, and churn fell

problemFoggy.title: Your focus feels foggy.
problemFoggy.body: You ticked {{k}} of {{total}} signs of a scattered mind. That's common, and it's the part you can train.
problemFoggy.bodyNone: You didn't tick any signs. Good. Most people only notice the slide once it has happened.

hoursBack.title: But you can get {{hours}} hours back.
hoursBack.body: That's what {{minutes}} minutes less a day adds up to over a year. Red is your pace now, green is with your goal.
hoursBack.chartLabel: Over a year, {{minutes}} minutes less a day gives you {{hours}} hours back.

momentOfPause.title: Meet your moment of pause.
momentOfPause.body: Open an app you've chosen to block and Untangle steps in, so you get to choose what happens next.
momentOfPause.artLabel: The pause screen: play a quick game, take a breath, or go back to your day.

art.title: A moment of pause
art.subtitle: Instagram · You've had your 30 min today.

stepOne.title: Blocking is step one. Focus is the goal.

block.title: Block the pull
block.body: Locks the apps that hook you once you've had your share.

practise.title: Practise focus
practise.body: Short games when the urge hits, and one round a day.

goal.title: Get your focus back
goal.body: Longer stretches without reaching for your phone. That is the real goal.

focusGrow.title: Watch your focus grow, week by week.
focusGrow.body: Your longest stretch without opening a blocked app.
focusGrow.caption: Example. Yours fills in from your first day.
focusGrow.chartLabel: Example chart: your longest stretch grows each week, up to 48 minutes in week 6.

permissions.title: Three quick permissions.
permissions.body: Untangle can't block anything without them. Your phone will ask for each one. Tap allow, and we'll bring you straight back.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: So we can step in when a blocked app opens

usage.title: Usage access
usage.body: Your real screen time and pick-ups

battery.title: Battery: Unrestricted
battery.body: So your phone never switches blocking off

permissions.footnote: Nothing leaves your phone. You can turn any of these off later in Settings.

restricted.title: Can't turn it on?
restricted.body: Some phones grey out Accessibility for apps from outside the Play Store until you allow it.

steps.two: Tap ⋮ in the top corner, then Allow restricted settings.

accessibility.title: Let Untangle see which app is open.
accessibility.body: So we can step in when you open a blocked app. We only check the app or site name, never your messages, and nothing leaves your phone.

pickApps.title: What should we block?
pickApps.body: We picked the usual suspects from your phone. Change anything.
pickApps.noSuspects: None of the usual ones are on this phone.
pickApps.cap: Free plan blocks up to 3. Go Pro for more.

sites.title: Which site?
sites.note: Blocks every page and subdomain, like old.reddit.com. Works in Chrome, Samsung Internet, Firefox, Edge, Brave and Opera.
sites.invalid: That doesn't look like a website address

allSet.title: You're all set.
allSet.body: Next time you open {{list}}, your moment of pause will be there.
allSet.bodyNone: Add an app to block any time from the Block tab.
